policy_effect: documentation-only; runtime_guard.py and the locked validator enforce denial

offline_acceptance.scope: Host/native regression, actual Linux offline pandad and F4/H7 ARM application builds only. Native F4/H7 policies are distinct from executing MCU hardware.

future_work.PHYSICAL_IDENTITY: Confirm each actual MCU/board, bus wiring, power and peripheral capabilities; product casing and synthetic fixture identities are not physical evidence.
future_work.TARGET_RUNTIME: Separately authorize and verify C3XL OS/camera/transport/thermal runtime after recovery prerequisites; offline pandad does not validate device runtime.
future_work.RECOVERY_CHAIN: Establish installed bootstub compatibility, trustworthy signing and recoverable backups with an independently demonstrated recovery procedure; do not infer this from app compilation.
future_work.DRIVER_MONITORING: Resolve and validate driver monitoring despite the sold-without-driver-camera product configuration; do not disable monitoring to satisfy readiness.
future_work.AUDIBLE_ALERTS: Validate audible alerts and loss-of-audio detection on actual hardware.
future_work.VEHICLE_CONTROL_SAFETY: Develop and independently validate Song PLUS signal interpretation, controller and dedicated Panda safety; legacy32/33 and current ATTO3 debug35 are not interchangeable.
future_work.RESOURCE_RUNTIME_LIMITS: Resolve worst-case nested stack and physical RAM/flash bounds, plus inherited H7 cookie/microphone overlap before claiming runtime resource safety.
future_work.CANDIDATE_TRUST: Replace public-development-key candidate trust only in a separately reviewed future design; this project has no installation package or bootstub replacement flow.

exit_status_contract.0: successful requested offline check/build/validation only; never means deployable
exit_status_contract.2: invalid or incomplete evidence, dependency/pin/artifact drift, or failed offline validation
exit_status_contract.3: release-check validated offline acceptance but deployment remains blocked; JSON must also be checked
